1.sahih_international: [The time of] their account has approached for the people, while they are in heedlessness turning away.
1.pickthall: Their reckoning draweth nigh for mankind, while they turn away in heedlessness.
1.yusuf_ali: Closer and closer to mankind comes their Reckoning: yet they heed not and they turn away.
1.shakir: Their reckoning has drawn near to men, and in heedlessness are they turning aside.
1.muhammad_sarwar: The people's day of reckoning is drawing closer, yet they are heedlessly neglectful.
1.mohsin_khan: Draws near for mankind their reckoning, while they turn away in heedlessness.
1.arberry: Nigh unto men has drawn their reckoning, while they in heedlessness are yet turning away;

2.sahih_international: No mention comes to them anew from their Lord except that they listen to it while they are at play
2.pickthall: Never cometh there unto them a new reminder from their Lord but they listen to it while they play,
2.yusuf_ali: Never comes (aught) to them of a renewed Message from their Lord, but they listen to it as in jest,-
2.shakir: There comes not to them a new reminder from their Lord but they hear it while they sport,
2.muhammad_sarwar: Whenever a new revelation comes to them from their Lord, they listen to it in a playful manner,
2.mohsin_khan: Comes not unto them an admonition (a chapter of the Quran) from their Lord as a recent revelation but they listen to it while they play,
2.arberry: no Remembrance from their Lord comes to them lately renewed, but they listen to it yet playing,

3.sahih_international: With their hearts distracted. And those who do wrong conceal their private conversation, [saying], "Is this [Prophet] except a human being like you? So would you approach magic while you are aware [of it]?"
3.pickthall: With hearts preoccupied. And they confer in secret. The wrong-doers say: Is this other than a mortal like you? Will ye then succumb to magic when ye see (it)?
3.yusuf_ali: Their hearts toying as with trifles. The wrong-doers conceal their private counsels, (saying), "Is this (one) more than a man like yourselves? Will ye go to witchcraft with your eyes open?"
3.shakir: Their hearts trifling; and those who are unjust counsel together in secret: He is nothing but a mortal like yourselves; what! will you then yield to enchantment while you see?
3.muhammad_sarwar: and their hearts are preoccupied with trivial matters. The unjust ones whisper to each other and say, "Is he (Muhammad) more than a mere mortal like you? How can you follow that which you know is only a magic?"
3.mohsin_khan: With their hearts occupied (with evil things) those who do wrong, conceal their private counsels, (saying): "Is this (Muhammad SAW) more than a human being like you? Will you submit to magic while you see it?"
3.arberry: diverted their hearts. The evildoers whisper one to another, 'Is this aught but a mortal like to yourselves? What, will you take to sorcery with your eyes open?'

4.sahih_international: The Prophet said, "My Lord knows whatever is said throughout the heaven and earth, and He is the Hearing, the Knowing."
4.pickthall: He saith: My Lord knoweth what is spoken in the heaven and the earth. He is the Hearer, the Knower.
4.yusuf_ali: Say: "My Lord knoweth (every) word (spoken) in the heavens and on earth: He is the One that heareth and knoweth (all things)."
4.shakir: He said: My Lord knows what is spoken in the heaven and the earth, and He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
4.muhammad_sarwar: The Lord said, "Tell them (Muhammad), 'My Lord knows all that is said in the heavens and the earth. He is All-hearing and All-knowing ".
4.mohsin_khan: He (Muhammad SAW) said: "My Lord knows (every) word (spoken) in the heavens and on earth. And He is the All-Hearer, the All-Knower."
4.arberry: He says: 'My Lord knows what is said in the heavens and the earth, and He is the All-hearing, the All-knowing.'

5.sahih_international: But they say, "[The revelation is but] a mixture of false dreams; rather, he has invented it; rather, he is a poet. So let him bring us a sign just as the previous [messengers] were sent [with miracles]."
5.pickthall: Nay, say they, (these are but) muddled dreams; nay, he hath but invented it; nay, he is but a poet. Let him bring us a portent even as those of old (who were Allah's messengers) were sent (with portents).
5.yusuf_ali: "Nay," they say, "(these are) medleys of dream! - Nay, He forged it! - Nay, He is (but) a poet! Let him then bring us a Sign like the ones that were sent to (Prophets) of old!"
5.shakir: Nay! say they: Medleys of dreams; nay! he has forged it; nay! he is a poet; so let him bring to us a sign as the former (prophets) were sent (with).
5.muhammad_sarwar: They have said, "It, (the Quran), is only the result of some confused dreams. He is only a poet. He should show us some miracles, as the ancient Prophets had done."
5.mohsin_khan: Nay, they say:"These (revelations of the Quran which are inspired to Muhammad SAW) are mixed up false dreams! Nay, he has invented it! Nay, he is a poet! Let him then bring us an Ayah (sign as a proof) like the ones (Prophets) that were sent before (with signs)!"
5.arberry: Nay, but they say: 'A hotchpotch of nightmares! Nay, he has forged it; nay, he is a poet! Now therefore let him bring us a sign, even as the ancient ones were sent as Messengers.'

6.sahih_international: Not a [single] city which We destroyed believed before them, so will they believe?
6.pickthall: Not a township believed of those which We destroyed before them (though We sent them portents): would they then believe?
6.yusuf_ali: (As to those) before them, not one of the populations which We destroyed believed: will these believe?
6.shakir: There did not believe before them any town which We destroyed, will they then believe?
6.muhammad_sarwar: The people of the town whom We had destroyed also had no faith. Will these people then believe in God?
6.mohsin_khan: Not one of the towns (populations), of those which We destroyed, believed before them (though We sent them signs), will they then believe?
6.arberry: Not one city that We destroyed before them believed; what then, will they not believe?

7.sahih_international: And We sent not before you, [O Muhammad], except men to whom We revealed [the message], so ask the people of the message if you do not know.
7.pickthall: And We sent not (as Our messengers) before thee other than men, whom We inspired. Ask the followers of the Reminder if ye know not?
7.yusuf_ali: Before thee, also, the messengers We sent were but men, to whom We granted inspiration: If ye realise this not, ask of those who possess the Message.
7.shakir: And We did not send before you any but men to whom We sent revelation, so ask the followers of the reminder if you do not
7.muhammad_sarwar: The messengers that We had sent before you were only men to whom We had given revelation. Ask the People of the Book if you do not know.
7.mohsin_khan: And We sent not before you (O Muhammad SAW) but men to whom We inspired, so ask the people of the Reminder [Scriptures - the Taurat (Torah), the Injeel (Gospel)] if you do not know.
7.arberry: And We sent none before thee, but men to whom We made revelation -- question the People of the Remembrance, if you do not know --

8.sahih_international: And We did not make the prophets forms not eating food, nor were they immortal [on earth].
8.pickthall: We gave them not bodies that would not eat food, nor were they immortals.
8.yusuf_ali: Nor did We give them bodies that ate no food, nor were they exempt from death.
8.shakir: And We did not make them bodies not eating the food, and they were not to abide (forever).
8.muhammad_sarwar: We had not made them such bodies that would not eat any food nor were they immortal.
8.mohsin_khan: And We did not create them (the Messengers, with) bodies that ate not food, nor were they immortals,
8.arberry: nor did We fashion them as bodies that ate not food, neither were they immortal;

9.sahih_international: Then We fulfilled for them the promise, and We saved them and whom We willed and destroyed the transgressors.
9.pickthall: Then we fulfilled the promise unto them. So we delivered them and whom We would, and We destroyed the prodigals.
9.yusuf_ali: In the end We fulfilled to them Our Promise, and We saved them and those whom We pleased, but We destroyed those who transgressed beyond bounds.
9.shakir: Then We made Our promise good to them, so We delivered them and those whom We pleased, and We destroyed the extravagant.
9.muhammad_sarwar: Our promise to them came true and We saved them and those whom We wanted, but destroyed the unjust people.
9.mohsin_khan: Then We fulfilled to them the promise, and We saved them and those whom We willed, but We destroyed Al-Musrifun (i.e. extravagants in oppression, polytheism and in sin).
9.arberry: then We made true the promise We gave them and We delivered them, and whomsoever We would; and We destroyed the prodigal.

10.sahih_international: We have certainly sent down to you a Book in which is your mention. Then will you not reason?
10.pickthall: Now We have revealed unto you a Scripture wherein is your Reminder. Have ye then no sense?
10.yusuf_ali: We have revealed for you (O men!) a book in which is a Message for you: will ye not then understand?
10.shakir: Certainly We have revealed to you a Book in which is your good remembrance; what! do you not then understand?
10.muhammad_sarwar: We have sent a Book, (the Quran), which is an honor for you. Will you then not understand?
10.mohsin_khan: Indeed, We have sent down for you (O mankind) a Book, (the Quran) in which there is Dhikrukum, (your Reminder or an honour for you i.e. honour for the one who follows the teaching of the Quran and acts on its orders). Will you not then understand?
10.arberry: Now We have sent down to you a Book wherein is your Remembrance; will you not understand?

11.sahih_international: And how many a city which was unjust have We shattered and produced after it another people.
11.pickthall: How many a community that dealt unjustly have We shattered, and raised up after them another folk!
11.yusuf_ali: How many were the populations We utterly destroyed because of their iniquities, setting up in their places other peoples?
11.shakir: And how many a town which was iniquitous did We demolish, and We raised up after it another people!
11.muhammad_sarwar: How many unjust towns did We destroy and replace them with other nations?
11.mohsin_khan: How many a town (community), that were wrong-doers, have We destroyed, and raised up after them another people!
11.arberry: How many a city that was evildoing We have shattered, and set up after it another people!

12.sahih_international: And when its inhabitants perceived Our punishment, at once they fled from it.
12.pickthall: And, when they felt Our might, behold them fleeing from it!
12.yusuf_ali: Yet, when they felt Our Punishment (coming), behold, they (tried to) flee from it.
12.shakir: So when they felt Our punishment, lo! they began to fly
12.muhammad_sarwar: When they found Our torment approaching them they started to run away from the town.
12.mohsin_khan: Then, when they perceived (saw) Our Torment (coming), behold, they (tried to) flee from it.
12.arberry: Then, when they perceived Our might, behold, they ran headlong out of it.

13.sahih_international: [Some angels said], "Do not flee but return to where you were given luxury and to your homes - perhaps you will be questioned."
13.pickthall: (But it was said unto them): Flee not, but return to that (existence) which emasculated you and to your dwellings, that ye may be questioned.
13.yusuf_ali: Flee not, but return to the good things of this life which were given you, and to your homes in order that ye may be called to account.
13.shakir: Do not fly (now) and come back to what you were made to lead easy lives in and to your dwellings, haply you will be questioned.
13.muhammad_sarwar: We told them, "Do not run away. Come back to your luxuries and your houses so that you can be questioned".
13.mohsin_khan: Flee not, but return to that wherein you lived a luxurious life, and to your homes, in order that you may be questioned.
13.arberry: 'Run not! Return you unto the luxury that you exulted in, and your dwelling-places; haply you shall be questioned.'

14.sahih_international: They said, "O woe to us! Indeed, we were wrongdoers."
14.pickthall: They cried: Alas for us! we were wrong-doers.
14.yusuf_ali: They said: "Ah! woe to us! We were indeed wrong-doers!"
14.shakir: They said: O woe to us! surely we were unjust.
14.muhammad_sarwar: They said, "Woe to us! We have been unjust".
14.mohsin_khan: They cried: "Woe to us! Certainly! We have been Zalimun (polytheists, wrong-doers and disbelievers in the Oneness of Allah, etc.)."
14.arberry: They said, 'Alas for us! We have been evildoers.'

15.sahih_international: And that declaration of theirs did not cease until We made them [as] a harvest [mowed down], extinguished [like a fire].
15.pickthall: And this their crying ceased not till We made them as reaped corn, extinct.
15.yusuf_ali: And that cry of theirs ceased not, till We made them as a field that is mown, as ashes silent and quenched.
15.shakir: And this ceased not to be their cry till We made them cut off, extinct.
15.muhammad_sarwar: Such was what they continued to say until We mowed them down and made them completely extinct.
15.mohsin_khan: And that cry of theirs ceased not, till We made them as a field that is reaped, extinct (dead).
15.arberry: So they ceased not to cry, until We made them stubble, silent and still.

16.sahih_international: And We did not create the heaven and earth and that between them in play.
16.pickthall: We created not the heaven and the earth and all that is between them in play.
16.yusuf_ali: Not for (idle) sport did We create the heavens and the earth and all that is between!
16.shakir: And We did not create the heaven and the earth and what is between them for sport.
16.muhammad_sarwar: We did not create the heavens and the earth just for fun.
16.mohsin_khan: We created not the heavens and the earth and all that is between them for a (mere) play.
16.arberry: We created not the heaven and the earth, and whatsoever between them is, as playing;

17.sahih_international: Had We intended to take a diversion, We could have taken it from [what is] with Us - if [indeed] We were to do so.
17.pickthall: If We had wished to find a pastime, We could have found it in Our presence - if We ever did.
17.yusuf_ali: If it had been Our wish to take (just) a pastime, We should surely have taken it from the things nearest to Us, if We would do (such a thing)!
17.shakir: Had We wished to make a diversion, We would have made it from before Ourselves: by no means would We do (it).
17.muhammad_sarwar: Had We wanted to play games, We could have certainly done so with things at hand.
17.mohsin_khan: Had We intended to take a pastime (i.e. a wife or a son, etc.), We could surely have taken it from Us, if We were going to do (that).
17.arberry: had We desired to take to Us a diversion We would have taken it to Us from Ourselves, had We done aught.

18.sahih_international: Rather, We dash the truth upon falsehood, and it destroys it, and thereupon it departs. And for you is destruction from that which you describe.
18.pickthall: Nay, but We hurl the true against the false, and it doth break its head and lo! it vanisheth. And yours will be woe for that which ye ascribe (unto Him).
18.yusuf_ali: Nay, We hurl the Truth against falsehood, and it knocks out its brain, and behold, falsehood doth perish! Ah! woe be to you for the (false) things ye ascribe (to Us).
18.shakir: Nay! We cast the truth against the falsehood, so that it breaks its head, and lo! it vanishes; and woe to you for what you describe;
18.muhammad_sarwar: We bring forward the Truth to crush and destroy falsehood; it is doomed to be banished. Woe to you for your way of thinking about God!
18.mohsin_khan: Nay, We fling (send down) the truth (this Quran) against the falsehood (disbelief), so it destroys it, and behold, it (falsehood) is vanished. And woe to you for that (lie) which you ascribe (to Us) (against Allah by uttering that Allah has a wife and a son).
18.arberry: Nay, but We hurl the truth against falsehood and it prevails over it, and behold, falsehood vanishes away. Then woe to you for that you describe!

19.sahih_international: To Him belongs whoever is in the heavens and the earth. And those near Him are not prevented by arrogance from His worship, nor do they tire.
19.pickthall: Unto Him belongeth whosoever is in the heavens and the earth. And those who dwell in His presence are not too proud to worship Him, nor do they weary;
19.yusuf_ali: To Him belong all (creatures) in the heavens and on earth: Even those who are in His (very) Presence are not too proud to serve Him, nor are they (ever) weary (of His service):
19.shakir: And whoever is in the heavens and the earth is His; and those who are with Him are not proud to serve Him, nor do they grow weary.
19.muhammad_sarwar: To Him belongs all those who are in the heavens and the earth. Those who are closer to Him are not too proud to worship Him, nor do they get tired of worshipping.
19.mohsin_khan: To Him belongs whosoever is in the heavens and on earth. And those who are near Him (i.e. the angels) are not too proud to worship Him, nor are they weary (of His worship).
19.arberry: To Him belongs whosoever is in the heavens and the earth; and those who are with Him wax not too proud to do Him service neither grow weary,

20.sahih_international: They exalt [Him] night and day [and] do not slacken.
20.pickthall: They glorify (Him) night and day; they flag not.
20.yusuf_ali: They celebrate His praises night and day, nor do they ever flag or intermit.
20.shakir: They glorify (Him) by night and day; they are never languid.
20.muhammad_sarwar: They glorify Him day and night without fail.
20.mohsin_khan: They (i.e. the angels) glorify His Praises night and day, (and) they never slacken (to do so).
20.arberry: glorifying Him by night and in the daytime and never failing.

21.sahih_international: Or have men taken for themselves gods from the earth who resurrect [the dead]?
21.pickthall: Or have they chosen gods from the earth who raise the dead?
21.yusuf_ali: Or have they taken (for worship) gods from the earth who can raise (the dead)?
21.shakir: Or have they taken gods from the earth who raise (the dead).
21.muhammad_sarwar: Have they chosen deities from earth? Can such deities give life to anyone?
21.mohsin_khan: Or have they taken (for worship) aliha (gods) from the earth who raise the dead?
21.arberry: Or have they taken gods out of the earth who raise the dead?

22.sahih_international: Had there been within the heavens and earth gods besides Allah, they both would have been ruined. So exalted is Allah, Lord of the Throne, above what they describe.
22.pickthall: If there were therein gods beside Allah, then verily both (the heavens and the earth) had been disordered. Glorified be Allah, the Lord of the Throne, from all that they ascribe (unto Him).
22.yusuf_ali: If there were, in the heavens and the earth, other gods besides Allah, there would have been confusion in both! but glory to Allah, the Lord of the Throne: (High is He) above what they attribute to Him!
22.shakir: If there had been in them any gods except Allah, they would both have certainly been in a state of disorder; therefore glory be to Allah, the Lord of the dominion, above what they attribute (to Him).
22.muhammad_sarwar: Had there been other deities in the heavens and the earth besides God, both the heavens and the earth would have been destroyed. God, the Lord of the Throne, is too Glorious to be as they think He is.
22.mohsin_khan: Had there been therein (in the heavens and the earth) gods besides Allah, then verily both would have been ruined. Glorified be Allah, the Lord of the Throne, (High is He) above what they attribute to Him!
22.arberry: Why, were there gods in earth and heaven other than God, they would surely go to ruin; so glory be to God, the Lord of the Throne, above that they describe!

23.sahih_international: He is not questioned about what He does, but they will be questioned.
23.pickthall: He will not be questioned as to that which He doeth, but they will be questioned.
23.yusuf_ali: He cannot be questioned for His acts, but they will be questioned (for theirs).
23.shakir: He cannot be questioned concerning what He does and they shall be questioned.
23.muhammad_sarwar: He will not be questioned about anything He does, but all people will be questioned about their deeds.
23.mohsin_khan: He cannot be questioned as to what He does, while they will be questioned.
23.arberry: He shall not be questioned as to what He does, but they shall he questioned.

24.sahih_international: Or have they taken gods besides Him? Say, [O Muhammad], "Produce your proof. This [Qur'an] is the message for those with me and the message of those before me." But most of them do not know the truth, so they are turning away.
24.pickthall: Or have they chosen other gods beside Him? say: Bring your proof (of their godhead). This is the Reminder of those with me and those before me, but most of them know not the Truth and so they are averse.
24.yusuf_ali: Or have they taken for worship (other) gods besides him? Say, "Bring your convincing proof: this is the Message of those with me and the Message of those before me." But most of them know not the Truth, and so turn away.
24.shakir: Or, have they taken gods besides Him? Say: Bring your proof; this is the reminder of those with me and the reminder of those before me. Nay! most of them do not know the truth, so they turn aside.
24.muhammad_sarwar: Have they chosen other gods besides God? (Muhammad), ask them, "Show the proof (in support of such belief). This is (the Quran) which tells us about the (beliefs of the people) in my time and those who lived before me." Most of them do not know. Moreover, the truth is that they neglect (the question of belief altogether).
24.mohsin_khan: Or have they taken for worship (other) aliha (gods) besides Him? Say: "Bring your proof:" This (the Quran) is the Reminder for those with me and the Reminder for those before me. But most of them know not the Truth, so they are averse.
24.arberry: Or have they taken gods apart from Him? Say: 'Bring your proof! This is the Remembrance of him who is with me, and the Remembrance of those before me. Nay, but the most part of them know not the truth, so therefore they are turning away.

25.sahih_international: And We sent not before you any messenger except that We revealed to him that, "There is no deity except Me, so worship Me."
25.pickthall: And We sent no messenger before thee but We inspired him, (saying): There is no Allah save Me (Allah), so worship Me.
25.yusuf_ali: Not a messenger did We send before thee without this inspiration sent by Us to him: that there is no god but I; therefore worship and serve Me.
25.shakir: And We did not send before you any apostle but We revealed to him that there is no god but Me, therefore serve Me.
25.muhammad_sarwar: To all the Messengers that were sent before you We revealed that I am the only God to be worshipped.
25.mohsin_khan: And We did not send any Messenger before you (O Muhammad SAW) but We inspired him (saying): La ilaha illa Ana [none has the right to be worshipped but I (Allah)], so worship Me (Alone and none else)."
25.arberry: And We sent never a Messenger before thee except that We revealed to him, saying, 'There is no god but I; so serve Me.'

26.sahih_international: And they say, "The Most Merciful has taken a son." Exalted is He! Rather, they are [but] honored servants.
26.pickthall: And they say: The Beneficent hath taken unto Himself a son. Be He Glorified! Nay, but (those whom they call sons) are honoured slaves;
26.yusuf_ali: And they say: "(Allah) Most Gracious has begotten offspring." Glory to Him! they are (but) servants raised to honour.
26.shakir: And they say: The Beneficent Allah has taken to Himself a son. Glory be to Him. Nay! they are honored servants
26.muhammad_sarwar: They said, "The Beneficent God has given birth to a son. He is too Exalted to give birth to a son." (Those whom they think are God's sons) are only His honorable servants.
26.mohsin_khan: And they say: "The Most Beneficent (Allah) has begotten a son (or children)." Glory to Him! They [those whom they call children of Allah i.e. the angels, 'Iesa (Jesus) son of Maryam (Mary), 'Uzair (Ezra), etc.], are but honoured slaves.
26.arberry: They say:' 'The All-merciful has taken to Him a son.' Glory be to Him! Nay, but they are honoured servants

27.sahih_international: They cannot precede Him in word, and they act by His command.
27.pickthall: They speak not until He hath spoken, and they act by His command.
27.yusuf_ali: They speak not before He speaks, and they act (in all things) by His Command.
27.shakir: They do not precede Him in speech and (only) according to His commandment do they act.
27.muhammad_sarwar: These servants do not speak before He speaks. They simply act according to His orders.
27.mohsin_khan: They speak not until He has spoken, and they act on His Command.
27.arberry: that outstrip Him not in speech, and perform as He commands.

28.sahih_international: He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, and they cannot intercede except on behalf of one whom He approves. And they, from fear of Him, are apprehensive.
28.pickthall: He knoweth what is before them and what is behind them, and they cannot intercede except for him whom He accepteth, and they quake for awe of Him.
28.yusuf_ali: He knows what is before them, and what is behind them, and they offer no intercession except for those who are acceptable, and they stand in awe and reverence of His (Glory).
28.shakir: He knows what is before them and what is behind them, and they do not intercede except for him whom He approves and for fear of Him they tremble.
28.muhammad_sarwar: He knows all that is in front of them and all that is behind them. (These servants of God) will not intercede with Him for anyone without His permission and they tremble in awe (before His greatness).
28.mohsin_khan: He knows what is before them, and what is behind them, and they cannot intercede except for him with whom He is pleased. And they stand in awe for fear of Him.
28.arberry: He knows what is before them and behind them, and they intercede not save for him with whom He is well-pleased, and they tremble in awe of Him.

29.sahih_international: And whoever of them should say, "Indeed, I am a god besides Him"- that one We would recompense with Hell. Thus do We recompense the wrongdoers.
29.pickthall: And one of them who should say: Lo! I am a god beside Him, that one We should repay with hell. Thus We Repay wrong-doers.
29.yusuf_ali: If any of them should say, "I am a god besides Him", such a one We should reward with Hell: thus do We reward those who do wrong.
29.shakir: And whoever of them should say: Surely I am a god besides Him, such a one do We recompense with hell; thus do, We recompense the unjust.
29.muhammad_sarwar: The recompense of those of them who say that they are the Lord instead of God will be hell; thus, do We recompense the unjust ones.
29.mohsin_khan: And if any of them should say: "Verily, I am an ilah (a god) besides Him (Allah)," such a one We should recompense with Hell. Thus We recompense the Zalimun (polytheists and wrong-doers, etc.).
29.arberry: If any of them says, 'I am a god apart from Him', such a one We recompense with Gehenna; even so We recompense the evildoers.

30.sahih_international: Have those who disbelieved not considered that the heavens and the earth were a joined entity, and We separated them and made from water every living thing? Then will they not believe?
30.pickthall: Have not those who disbelieve known that the heavens and the earth were of one piece, then We parted them, and we made every living thing of water? Will they not then believe?
30.yusuf_ali: Do not the Unbelievers see that the heavens and the earth were joined together (as one unit of creation), before we clove them asunder? We made from water every living thing. Will they not then believe?
30.shakir: Do not those who disbelieve see that the heavens and the earth were closed up, but We have opened them; and We have made of water everything living, will they not then believe?
30.muhammad_sarwar: Have the unbelievers not ever considered that the heavens and the earth were one piece and that We tore them apart from one another. From water We have created all living things. Will they then have no faith?
30.mohsin_khan: Have not those who disbelieve known that the heavens and the earth were joined together as one united piece, then We parted them? And We have made from water every living thing. Will they not then believe?
30.arberry: Have not the unbelievers then beheld that the heavens and the earth were a mass all sewn up, and then We unstitched them and of water fashioned every living thing? Will they not believe?

31.sahih_international: And We placed within the earth firmly set mountains, lest it should shift with them, and We made therein [mountain] passes [as] roads that they might be guided.
31.pickthall: And We have placed in the earth firm hills lest it quake with them, and We have placed therein ravines as roads that haply they may find their way.
31.yusuf_ali: And We have set on the earth mountains standing firm, lest it should shake with them, and We have made therein broad highways (between mountains) for them to pass through: that they may receive Guidance.
31.shakir: And We have made great mountains in the earth lest it might be convulsed with them, and We have made in it wide ways that they may follow a right direction.
31.muhammad_sarwar: We placed firm mountains on earth lest it would shake them away. We made wide roads for them so that they might have the right guidance.
31.mohsin_khan: And We have placed on the earth firm mountains, lest it should shake with them, and We placed therein broad highways for them to pass through, that they may be guided.
31.arberry: And We set in the earth firm mountains lest it should shake with them, and We set in it ravines to serve as ways, that haply so they may be guided;

32.sahih_international: And We made the sky a protected ceiling, but they, from its signs, are turning away.
32.pickthall: And we have made the sky a roof withheld (from them). Yet they turn away from its portents.
32.yusuf_ali: And We have made the heavens as a canopy well guarded: yet do they turn away from the Signs which these things (point to)!
32.shakir: And We have made the heaven a guarded canopy and (yet) they turn aside from its signs.
32.muhammad_sarwar: We made the sky above them as a well-guarded ceiling, but they have neglected the evidence (of Our existence) therein.
32.mohsin_khan: And We have made the heaven a roof, safe and well guarded. Yet they turn away from its signs (i.e. sun, moon, winds, clouds, etc.).
32.arberry: and We set up the heaven as a roof well-protected; yet still from Our signs they are turning away.

33.sahih_international: And it is He who created the night and the day and the sun and the moon; all [heavenly bodies] in an orbit are swimming.
33.pickthall: And He it is Who created the night and the day, and the sun and the moon. They float, each in an orbit.
33.yusuf_ali: It is He Who created the Night and the Day, and the sun and the moon: all (the celestial bodies) swim along, each in its rounded course.
33.shakir: And He it is Who created the night and the day and the sun and the moon; all (orbs) travel along swiftly in their celestial spheres.
33.muhammad_sarwar: It is God who has created the night, the day, the Sun, and Moon and has made them swim in a certain orbit.
33.mohsin_khan: And He it is Who has created the night and the day, and the sun and the moon, each in an orbit floating.
33.arberry: It is He who created the night and the day, the sun and the moon, each swimming in a sky.

34.sahih_international: And We did not grant to any man before you eternity [on earth]; so if you die - would they be eternal?
34.pickthall: We appointed immortality for no mortal before thee. What! if thou diest, can they be immortal!
34.yusuf_ali: We granted not to any man before thee permanent life (here): if then thou shouldst die, would they live permanently?
34.shakir: And We did not ordain abiding for any mortal before you. What! Then if you die, will they abide?
34.muhammad_sarwar: We made no mortal before you immortal. Will they become immortal after you die?
34.mohsin_khan: And We granted not to any human being immortality before you (O Muhammad SAW), then if you die, would they live forever?
34.arberry: We have not assigned to any mortal before thee to live forever; therefore, if thou diest, will they live forever?

35.sahih_international: Every soul will taste death. And We test you with evil and with good as trial; and to Us you will be returned.
35.pickthall: Every soul must taste of death, and We try you with evil and with good, for ordeal. And unto Us ye will be returned.
35.yusuf_ali: Every soul shall have a taste of death: and We test you by evil and by good by way of trial. to Us must ye return.
35.shakir: Every soul must taste of death and We try you by evil and good by way of probation; and to Us you shall be brought back.
35.muhammad_sarwar: Every soul has to experience the taste of death. We test you with both hardships and blessings. In the end you will all return to Us.
35.mohsin_khan: Everyone is going to taste death, and We shall make a trial of you with evil and with good, and to Us you will be returned.
35.arberry: Every soul shall taste of death; and We try you with evil and good for a testing, then unto Us you shall be returned.

36.sahih_international: And when those who disbelieve see you, [O Muhammad], they take you not except in ridicule, [saying], "Is this the one who insults your gods?" And they are, at the mention of the Most Merciful, disbelievers.
36.pickthall: And when those who disbelieve behold thee, they but choose thee out for mockery, (saying): Is this he who maketh mention of your gods? And they would deny all mention of the Beneficent.
36.yusuf_ali: When the Unbelievers see thee, they treat thee not except with ridicule. "Is this," (they say), "the one who talks of your gods?" and they blaspheme at the mention of (Allah) Most Gracious!
36.shakir: And when those who disbelieve see you, they do not take you but for one to be scoffed at: Is this he who speaks of your gods? And they are deniers at the mention of the Beneficent Allah.
36.muhammad_sarwar: (Muhammad), whenever the unbelievers see you, they think that you deserve nothing more than to be mocked. They say, "Is it he, (Muhammad), who speaks against your gods?" But they themselves have no faith at all in the Beneficent God.
36.mohsin_khan: And when those who disbelieve (in the Oneness of Allah) see you (O Muhammad SAW), they take you not except for mockery (saying): "Is this the one who talks (badly) about your gods?" While they disbelieve at the mention of the Most Beneficent (Allah). [Tafsir. Al-Qurtubi].
36.arberry: When the unbelievers behold thee, they take thee only for mockery: 'Ha, is this the one who makes mention of your gods?' Yet they in the Remembrance of the All-merciful are unbelievers.

37.sahih_international: Man was created of haste. I will show you My signs, so do not impatiently urge Me.
37.pickthall: Man is made of haste. I shall show you My portents, but ask Me not to hasten.
37.yusuf_ali: Man is a creature of haste: soon (enough) will I show you My Signs; then ye will not ask Me to hasten them!
37.shakir: Man is created of haste; now will I show to you My signs, therefore do not ask Me to hasten (them) on.
37.muhammad_sarwar: The human being is created hasty. Tell them, "Do not be hasty, for God will soon show you the evidence of His existence".
37.mohsin_khan: Man is created of haste, I will show you My Ayat (torments, proofs, evidences, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.). So ask Me not to hasten (them).
37.arberry: Man was created of haste. Assuredly I shall show you My signs; so demand not that I make haste.

38.sahih_international: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"
38.pickthall: And they say: When will this promise (be fulfilled), if ye are truthful?
38.yusuf_ali: They say: "When will this promise come to pass, if ye are telling the truth?"
38.shakir: And they say: When will this threat come to pass if you are truthful?
38.muhammad_sarwar: They say, "When shall the Day of Judgment come to pass if you are true in your claim?"
38.mohsin_khan: And they say: "When will this promise (come to pass), if you are truthful."
38.arberry: They say, 'And when shall the promise come to pass, if you speak truly?'

39.sahih_international: If those who disbelieved but knew the time when they will not avert the Fire from their faces or from their backs and they will not be aided...
39.pickthall: If those who disbelieved but knew the time when they will not be able to drive off the fire from their faces and from their backs, and they will not be helped!
39.yusuf_ali: If only the Unbelievers knew (the time) when they will not be able to ward off the fire from their faces, nor yet from their backs, and (when) no help can reach them!
39.shakir: Had those who disbelieve but known (of the time) when they shall not be able to ward off the fire from their faces nor from their backs, nor shall they be helped.
39.muhammad_sarwar: Would that the unbelievers knew that no one would protect their faces and backs against the fire, nor they would be helped.
39.mohsin_khan: If only those who disbelieved knew (the time) when they will not be able to ward off the Fire from their faces, nor from their backs; and they will not be helped.
39.arberry: If the unbelievers but knew when that they shall not ward off the Fire from their faces nor from their backs, neither shall they be helped!

40.sahih_international: Rather, it will come to them unexpectedly and bewilder them, and they will not be able to repel it, nor will they be reprieved.
40.pickthall: Nay, but it will come upon them unawares so that it will stupefy them, and they will be unable to repel it, neither will they be reprieved.
40.yusuf_ali: Nay, it may come to them all of a sudden and confound them: no power will they have then to avert it, nor will they (then) get respite.
40.shakir: Nay, it shall come on them all of a sudden and cause them to become confounded, so they shall not have the power to avert it, nor shall they be respited.
40.muhammad_sarwar: The fire will suddenly strike and confound them. They will not be able to repel it, nor will they be given any respite.
40.mohsin_khan: Nay, it (the Fire or the Day of Resurrection) will come upon them all of a sudden and will perplex them, and they will have no power to avert it, nor will they get respite.
40.arberry: Nay, but it shall come upon them suddenly, dumbfounding them, and they shall not be able to repel it, nor shall they be respited.

41.sahih_international: And already were messengers ridiculed before you, but those who mocked them were enveloped by what they used to ridicule.
41.pickthall: Messengers before thee, indeed, were mocked, but that whereat they mocked surrounded those who scoffed at them.
41.yusuf_ali: Mocked were (many) messenger before thee; But their scoffers were hemmed in by the thing that they mocked.
41.shakir: And certainly apostles before you were scoffed at, then there befell those of them who scoffed that at which they had scoffed.
41.muhammad_sarwar: They mocked the Messengers who were sent before you; thus, the torment which they had ridiculed encompassed them all.
41.mohsin_khan: Indeed (many) Messengers were mocked before you (O Muhammad SAW), but the scoffers were surrounded by that, whereat they used to mock.
41.arberry: Messengers indeed were mocked at before thee, but those that scoffed at them were encompassed by that they mocked at.

42.sahih_international: Say, "Who can protect you at night or by day from the Most Merciful?" But they are, from the remembrance of their Lord, turning away.
42.pickthall: Say: Who guardeth you in the night or in the day from the Beneficent? Nay, but they turn away from mention of their Lord!
42.yusuf_ali: Say: "Who can keep you safe by night and by day from (the Wrath of) (Allah) Most Gracious?" Yet they turn away from the mention of their Lord.
42.shakir: Say: Who guards you by night and by day from the Beneficent Allah? Nay, they turn aside at the mention of their Lord.
42.muhammad_sarwar: Ask them, "Who can protect them from (the wrath of) the Beneficent God during the night and day?" Yet they are neglectful about their Lord.
42.mohsin_khan: Say: "Who can guard and protect you in the night or in the day from the (punishment of the) Most Beneficent (Allah)?" Nay, but they turn away from the remembrance of their Lord.
42.arberry: Say: 'Who shall guard you by night and in the daytime from the All-merciful?' Nay, but from the Remembrance of their Lord they are turning away.

43.sahih_international: Or do they have gods to defend them other than Us? They are unable [even] to help themselves, nor can they be protected from Us.
43.pickthall: Or have they gods who can shield them from Us? They cannot help themselves nor can they be defended from Us.
43.yusuf_ali: Or have they gods that can guard them from Us? They have no power to aid themselves, nor can they be defended from Us.
43.shakir: Or, have they gods who can defend them against Us? They shall not be able to assist themselves, nor shall they be defended from Us.
43.muhammad_sarwar: Can their gods protect them against Us? Their gods have no power even to help themselves, nor are they safe from Our retribution.
43.mohsin_khan: Or have they aliha (gods) who can guard them from Us? They have no power to help themselves, nor can they be protected from Us (i.e. from Our Torment).
43.arberry: Or have they gods that shall defend them apart from Us? Why, they are not able to help themselves, nor shall they be guarded in safety from Us.

44.sahih_international: But, [on the contrary], We have provided good things for these [disbelievers] and their fathers until life was prolonged for them. Then do they not see that We set upon the land, reducing it from its borders? So it is they who will overcome?
44.pickthall: Nay, but We gave these and their fathers ease until life grew long for them. See they not how we aim to the land, reducing it of its outlying parts? Can they then be the victors?
44.yusuf_ali: Nay, We gave the good things of this life to these men and their fathers until the period grew long for them; See they not that We gradually reduce the land (in their control) from its outlying borders? Is it then they who will win?
44.shakir: Nay, We gave provision to these and their fathers until life was prolonged to them. Do they not then see that We are visiting the land, curtailing it of its sides? Shall they then prevail?
44.muhammad_sarwar: We have been providing these men and their fathers with the means of enjoyment for a long time. Have they not ever considered that We populated the earth and then caused many of the inhabitants to pass away? Can they have any success (in their wickedness)?
44.mohsin_khan: Nay, We gave the luxuries of this life to these men and their fathers until the period grew long for them. See they not that We gradually reduce the land (in their control) from its outlying borders? Is it then they who will overcome.
44.arberry: Nay, but Ourselves gave these and their fathers enjoyment of days, until their life had lasted long while upon them. What, do they not see how We come to the land, diminishing it in its extremities? Or are they the victors?

45.sahih_international: Say, "I only warn you by revelation." But the deaf do not hear the call when they are warned.
45.pickthall: Say (O Muhammad, unto mankind): I warn you only by the Inspiration. But the deaf hear not the call when they are warned.
45.yusuf_ali: Say, "I do but warn you according to revelation": But the deaf will not hear the call, (even) when they are warned!
45.shakir: Say: I warn you only by revelation; and the deaf do not hear the call whenever they are warned.
45.muhammad_sarwar: (Muhammad), tell them, "I am warning you by revelation alone." The deaf do not hear any call when they are warned.
45.mohsin_khan: Say (O Muhammad SAW): "I warn you only by the revelation (from Allah and not by the opinion of the religious scholars and others). But the deaf (who follow the religious scholars and others blindly) will not hear the call, (even) when they are warned [(i.e. one should follow only the Quran and the Sunnah (legal ways, orders, acts of worship, statements of Prophet Muhammad SAW, as the Companions of the Prophet SAW did)].
45.arberry: Say: 'I warn you only by the Revelation'; but they that are deaf do not hear the call when they are warned.

46.sahih_international: And if [as much as] a whiff of the punishment of your Lord should touch them, they would surely say, "O woe to us! Indeed, we have been wrongdoers."
46.pickthall: And if a breath of thy Lord's punishment were to touch them, they assuredly would say: Alas for us! Lo! we were wrong-doers.
46.yusuf_ali: If but a breath of the Wrath of thy Lord do touch them, they will then say, "Woe to us! we did wrong indeed!"
46.shakir: And if a blast of the chastisement of your Lord were to touch them, they will certainly say: O woe to us! surely we were unjust.
46.muhammad_sarwar: If a blast of the torment of your Lord strikes them, they will say, "Woe to us! We have been unjust people."
46.mohsin_khan: And if a breath (minor calamity) of the Torment of your Lord touches them, they will surely cry: "Woe unto us! Indeed we have been Zalimun (polytheists and wrong-doers, etc.).
46.arberry: If but a breath of thy Lord's chastisement touched them, they would surely say, 'Alas for us! We were evildoers.'

47.sahih_international: And We place the scales of justice for the Day of Resurrection, so no soul will be treated unjustly at all. And if there is [even] the weight of a mustard seed, We will bring it forth. And sufficient are We as accountant.
47.pickthall: And We set a just balance for the Day of Resurrection so that no soul is wronged in aught. Though it be of the weight of a grain of mustard seed, We bring it. And We suffice for reckoners.
47.yusuf_ali: We shall set up scales of justice for the Day of Judgment, so that not a soul will be dealt with unjustly in the least, and if there be (no more than) the weight of a mustard seed, We will bring it (to account): and enough are We to take account.
47.shakir: And We will set up a just balance on the day of resurrection, so no soul shall be dealt with unjustly in the least; and though there be the weight of a grain of mustard seed, (yet) will We bring it, and sufficient are We to take account.
47.muhammad_sarwar: We shall maintain proper justice on the Day of Judgment. No soul will be wronged the least. For a deed even as small as a mustard seed one will duly be recompensed. We are efficient in maintaining the account.
47.mohsin_khan: And We shall set up balances of justice on the Day of Resurrection, then none will be dealt with unjustly in anything. And if there be the weight of a mustard seed, We will bring it. And Sufficient are We as Reckoners.
47.arberry: And We shall set up the just balances for the Resurrection Day, so that not one soul shall be wronged anything; even if it be the weight of one grain of mustard-seed We shall produce it, and sufficient are We for reckoners.

48.sahih_international: And We had already given Moses and Aaron the criterion and a light and a reminder for the righteous
48.pickthall: And We verily gave Moses and Aaron the Criterion (of right and wrong) and a light and a Reminder for those who keep from evil,
48.yusuf_ali: In the past We granted to Moses and Aaron the criterion (for judgment), and a Light and a Message for those who would do right,-
48.shakir: And certainly We gave to Musa and Haroun the Furqan and a light and a reminder for those who would guard (against evil).
48.muhammad_sarwar: To Moses and Aaron We granted the criteria of discerning right from wrong, and We gave them the light and a reminder to the pious ones
48.mohsin_khan: And indeed We granted to Musa (Moses) and Harun (Aaron) the criterion (of right and wrong), and a shining light [i.e. the Taurat (Torah)] and a Reminder for Al-Muttaqun (the pious - see V. 2:2).
48.arberry: We gave Moses and Aaron the Salvation and a Radiance, and a Remembrance for the godfearing

49.sahih_international: Who fear their Lord unseen, while they are of the Hour apprehensive.
49.pickthall: Those who fear their Lord in secret and who dread the Hour (of doom).
49.yusuf_ali: Those who fear their Lord in their most secret thoughts, and who hold the Hour (of Judgment) in awe.
49.shakir: (For) those who fear their Lord in secret and they are fearful of the hour.
49.muhammad_sarwar: who fear their unseen Lord and are anxious about the Day of Judgment.
49.mohsin_khan: Those who fear their Lord without seeing Him, while they are afraid of the Hour.
49.arberry: such as fear God in the Unseen, trembling because of the Hour.

50.sahih_international: And this [Qur'an] is a blessed message which We have sent down. Then are you with it unacquainted?
50.pickthall: This is a blessed Reminder that we have revealed: Will ye then reject it?
50.yusuf_ali: And this is a blessed Message which We have sent down: will ye then reject it?
50.shakir: And this is a blessed Reminder which We have revealed; will you then deny it?
50.muhammad_sarwar: This (Quran) which We have revealed is a blessed reminder. Will you then deny it?
50.mohsin_khan: And this is a blessed Reminder (the Quran) which We have sent down, will you then (dare to) deny it?
50.arberry: And this is a blessed Remembrance that We have sent down; so are you now denying it?

51.sahih_international: And We had certainly given Abraham his sound judgement before, and We were of him well-Knowing
51.pickthall: And We verily gave Abraham of old his proper course, and We were Aware of him,
51.yusuf_ali: We bestowed aforetime on Abraham his rectitude of conduct, and well were We acquainted with him.
51.shakir: And certainly We gave to Ibrahim his rectitude before, and We knew him fully well.
51.muhammad_sarwar: To Abraham We gave the right guidance and We knew him very well.
51.mohsin_khan: And indeed We bestowed aforetime on Ibrahim (Abraham) his (portion of) guidance, and We were Well-Acquainted with him (as to his Belief in the Oneness of Allah, etc.).
51.arberry: We gave Abraham aforetime his rectitude -- for We knew him --

52.sahih_international: When he said to his father and his people, "What are these statues to which you are devoted?"
52.pickthall: When he said unto his father and his folk: What are these images unto which ye pay devotion?
52.yusuf_ali: Behold! he said to his father and his people, "What are these images, to which ye are (so assiduously) devoted?"
52.shakir: When he said to his father and his people: What are these images to whose worship you cleave?
52.muhammad_sarwar: Abraham asked his father and his people, "What are these statues which you worship?"
52.mohsin_khan: When he said to his father and his people: "What are these images, to which you are devoted?"
52.arberry: when he said to his father and his people, 'What are these statues unto which you are cleaving?'

53.sahih_international: They said, "We found our fathers worshippers of them."
53.pickthall: They said: We found our fathers worshippers of them.
53.yusuf_ali: They said, "We found our fathers worshipping them."
53.shakir: They said: We found our fathers worshipping them.
53.muhammad_sarwar: They replied, "We found our fathers worshipping them".
53.mohsin_khan: They said:"We found our fathers worshipping them."
53.arberry: They said, 'We found our fathers serving them.'

54.sahih_international: He said, "You were certainly, you and your fathers, in manifest error."
54.pickthall: He said: Verily ye and your fathers were in plain error.
54.yusuf_ali: He said, "Indeed ye have been in manifest error - ye and your fathers."
54.shakir: He said: Certainly you have been, (both) you and your fathers, in manifest error.
54.muhammad_sarwar: He said, "Both you and your fathers have certainly been in error."
54.mohsin_khan: He said: "Indeed you and your fathers have been in manifest error."
54.arberry: He said, 'Then assuredly you and your fathers have been in manifest error.'

55.sahih_international: They said, "Have you come to us with truth, or are you of those who jest?"
55.pickthall: They said: Bringest thou unto us the truth, or art thou some jester?
55.yusuf_ali: They said, "Have you brought us the Truth, or are you one of those who jest?"
55.shakir: They said: Have you brought to us the truth, or are you one of the triflers?
55.muhammad_sarwar: They exclaimed, "Have you brought the Truth or are you joking?"
55.mohsin_khan: They said: "Have you brought us the truth, or are you one of those who play about?"
55.arberry: They said, 'What, hast thou come to us with the truth, or art thou one of those that play?'

56.sahih_international: He said, "[No], rather, your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth who created them, and I, to that, am of those who testify.
56.pickthall: He said: Nay, but your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, Who created them; and I am of those who testify unto that.
56.yusuf_ali: He said, "Nay, your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, He Who created them (from nothing): and I am a witness to this (Truth).
56.shakir: He said: Nay! your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, Who brought them into existence, and I am of those who bear witness to this:
56.muhammad_sarwar: He said, "Your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth. It was He who created them and I testify to this fact".
56.mohsin_khan: He said: "Nay, your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, Who created them and of that I am one of the witnesses.
56.arberry: He said, 'Nay, but your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth who originated them, and I am one of those that bear witness thereunto.

57.sahih_international: And [I swear] by Allah, I will surely plan against your idols after you have turned and gone away."
57.pickthall: And, by Allah, I shall circumvent your idols after ye have gone away and turned your backs.
57.yusuf_ali: "And by Allah, I have a plan for your idols - after ye go away and turn your backs"..
57.shakir: And, by Allah! I will certainly do something against your idols after you go away, turning back.
57.muhammad_sarwar: Abraham said to himself, "By God! I will devise a plan against their idols when they are away."
57.mohsin_khan: "And by Allah, I shall plot a plan (to destroy) your idols after you have gone away and turned your backs."
57.arberry: And, by God, I shall assuredly outwit your idols, after you have gone away turning your backs.'

58.sahih_international: So he made them into fragments, except a large one among them, that they might return to it [and question].
58.pickthall: Then he reduced them to fragments, all save the chief of them, that haply they might have recourse to it.
58.yusuf_ali: So he broke them to pieces, (all) but the biggest of them, that they might turn (and address themselves) to it.
58.shakir: So he broke them into pieces, except the chief of them, that haply they may return to it.
58.muhammad_sarwar: He broke all the idols into pieces, except the biggest among them so that perhaps people would refer to it.
58.mohsin_khan: So he broke them to pieces, (all) except the biggest of them, that they might turn to it.
58.arberry: So he broke them into fragments, all but a great one they had, for haply they would return to it.

59.sahih_international: They said, "Who has done this to our gods? Indeed, he is of the wrongdoers."
59.pickthall: They said: Who hath done this to our gods? Surely it must be some evil-doer.
59.yusuf_ali: They said, "Who has done this to our gods? He must indeed be some man of impiety!"
59.shakir: They said: Who has done this to our gods? Most surely he is one of the unjust.
59.muhammad_sarwar: (When the people came to the temple and saw the broken idols) they asked each other, "Who has done this to our gods? He certainly is an unjust person".
59.mohsin_khan: They said: "Who has done this to our aliha (gods)? He must indeed be one of the wrong-doers."
59.arberry: They said, 'Who has. done this with our gods? Surely he is one of the evildoers.'

60.sahih_international: They said, "We heard a young man mention them who is called Abraham."
60.pickthall: They said: We heard a youth make mention of them, who is called Abraham.
60.yusuf_ali: They said, "We heard a youth talk of them: He is called Abraham."
60.shakir: They said: We heard a youth called Ibrahim speak of them.
60.muhammad_sarwar: Some of them said, "We heard a youth called Abraham speaking against the idols".
60.mohsin_khan: They said: "We heard a young man talking (against) them who is called Ibrahim (Abraham)."
60.arberry: They said, 'We heard a young man making mention of them, and he was called Abraham.'

61.sahih_international: They said, "Then bring him before the eyes of the people that they may testify."
61.pickthall: They said: Then bring him (hither) before the people's eyes that they may testify.
61.yusuf_ali: They said, "Then bring him before the eyes of the people, that they may bear witness."
61.shakir: Said they: Then bring him before the eyes of the people, perhaps they may bear witness.
61.muhammad_sarwar: Their chiefs said, "Bring him before the eyes of the people and let them testify that he has spoken against the idols."
61.mohsin_khan: They said: "Then bring him before the eyes of the people, that they may testify."
61.arberry: They said, 'Bring him before the people's eyes; haply they shall bear witness.'

62.sahih_international: They said, "Have you done this to our gods, O Abraham?"
62.pickthall: They said: Is it thou who hast done this to our gods, O Abraham?
62.yusuf_ali: They said, "Art thou the one that did this with our gods, O Abraham?"
62.shakir: They said: Have you done this to our gods, O Ibrahim?
62.muhammad_sarwar: They asked, "Abraham, did you do this to our idols?"
62.mohsin_khan: They said: "Are you the one who has done this to our gods, O Ibrahim (Abraham)?"
62.arberry: They said, 'So, art thou the man who did this unto our gods, Abraham?'

63.sahih_international: He said, "Rather, this - the largest of them - did it, so ask them, if they should [be able to] speak."
63.pickthall: He said: But this, their chief hath done it. So question them, if they can speak.
63.yusuf_ali: He said: "Nay, this was done by - this is their biggest one! ask them, if they can speak intelligently!"
63.shakir: He said: Surely (some doer) has done it; the chief of them is this, therefore ask them, if they can speak.
63.muhammad_sarwar: He replied, "I think the biggest among them has broken the smaller ones. Ask them if they are able to speak".
63.mohsin_khan: [Ibrahim (Abraham)] said: "Nay, this one, the biggest of them (idols) did it. Ask them, if they can speak!"
63.arberry: He said, 'No; it was this great one of them that did it. Question them; if they are able to speak!'

64.sahih_international: So they returned to [blaming] themselves and said [to each other], "Indeed, you are the wrongdoers."
64.pickthall: Then gathered they apart and said: Lo! ye yourselves are the wrong-doers.
64.yusuf_ali: So they turned to themselves and said, "Surely ye are the ones in the wrong!"
64.shakir: Then they turned to themselves and said: Surely you yourselves are the unjust;
64.muhammad_sarwar: Thereupon they realized their own foolishness and said, "We ourselves are wrong-doers".
64.mohsin_khan: So they turned to themselves and said: "Verily, you are the Zalimun (polytheists and wrong-doers)."
64.arberry: So they returned one to another, and they said, 'Surely it is you who are the evildoers.'

65.sahih_international: Then they reversed themselves, [saying], "You have already known that these do not speak!"
65.pickthall: And they were utterly confounded, and they said: Well thou knowest that these speak not.
65.yusuf_ali: Then were they confounded with shame: (they said), "Thou knowest full well that these (idols) do not speak!"
65.shakir: Then they were made to hang down their heads: Certainly you know that they do not speak.
65.muhammad_sarwar: With their heads cast down they said, "Abraham, you know that idols do not speak. How then can you ask such a question?"
65.mohsin_khan: Then they turned to themselves (their first thought and said): "Indeed you [Ibrahim (Abraham)] know well that these (idols) speak not!"
65.arberry: Then they were utterly put to confusion saying, 'Very well indeed thou knowest these do not speak.'

66.sahih_international: He said, "Then do you worship instead of Allah that which does not benefit you at all or harm you?
66.pickthall: He said: Worship ye then instead of Allah that which cannot profit you at all, nor harm you?
66.yusuf_ali: (Abraham) said, "Do ye then worship, besides Allah, things that can neither be of any good to you nor do you harm?
66.shakir: He said: What! do you then serve besides Allah what brings you not any benefit at all, nor does it harm you?
66.muhammad_sarwar: He said, "Do you, instead of God, worship things that can neither harm nor benefit you?"
66.mohsin_khan: [Ibrahim (Abraham)] said: "Do you then worship besides Allah, things that can neither profit you, nor harm you?
66.arberry: He said, 'What, and do you serve, apart from God, that which profits you nothing; neither hurts you?

67.sahih_international: Uff to you and to what you worship instead of Allah. Then will you not use reason?"
67.pickthall: Fie on you and all that ye worship instead of Allah! Have ye then no sense?
67.yusuf_ali: "Fie upon you, and upon the things that ye worship besides Allah! Have ye no sense?"..
67.shakir: Fie on you and on what you serve besides Allah; what! do you not then understand?
67.muhammad_sarwar: Woe to you for what you worship instead of God. Have you no understanding?"
67.mohsin_khan: "Fie upon you, and upon that which you worship besides Allah! Have you then no sense?"
67.arberry: Fie upon you and that you serve apart from God! Do you not understand?'

68.sahih_international: They said, "Burn him and support your gods - if you are to act."
68.pickthall: They cried: Burn him and stand by your gods, if ye will be doing.
68.yusuf_ali: They said, "Burn him and protect your gods, If ye do (anything at all)!"
68.shakir: They said: Burn him and help your gods, if you are going to do (anything).
68.muhammad_sarwar: They said, "Burn him to ashes if you want to help your gods".
68.mohsin_khan: They said: "Burn him and help your aliha (gods), if you will be doing."
68.arberry: They said, 'Burn him, and help your gods, if you would do aught.'

69.sahih_international: Allah said, "O fire, be coolness and safety upon Abraham."
69.pickthall: We said: O fire, be coolness and peace for Abraham,
69.yusuf_ali: We said, "O Fire! be thou cool, and (a means of) safety for Abraham!"
69.shakir: We said: O fire! be a comfort and peace to Ibrahim;
69.muhammad_sarwar: We said to the fire, "Be cool and peaceful (with Abraham)".
69.mohsin_khan: We (Allah) said: "O fire! Be you coolness and safety for Ibrahim (Abraham)!"
69.arberry: We said, 'O fire, be coolness and safety for Abraham!'

70.sahih_international: And they intended for him harm, but We made them the greatest losers.
70.pickthall: And they wished to set a snare for him, but We made them the greater losers.
70.yusuf_ali: Then they sought a stratagem against him: but We made them the ones that lost most!
70.shakir: And they desired a war on him, but We made them the greatest losers.
70.muhammad_sarwar: They had devised an evil plan (against Abraham), but We turned it into failure."
70.mohsin_khan: And they wanted to harm him, but We made them the worst losers.
70.arberry: They desired to outwit him; so We made them the worse losers,

71.sahih_international: And We delivered him and Lot to the land which We had blessed for the worlds.
71.pickthall: And We rescued him and Lot (and brought them) to the land which We have blessed for (all) peoples.
71.yusuf_ali: But We delivered him and (his nephew) Lut (and directed them) to the land which We have blessed for the nations.
71.shakir: And We delivered him as well as Lut (removing them) to the land which We had blessed for all people.
71.muhammad_sarwar: We took Abraham and Lot safely to the land in which We had sent blessings to the worlds.
71.mohsin_khan: And We rescued him and Lout (Lot) to the land which We have blessed for the 'Alamin (mankind and jinns).
71.arberry: and We delivered him, and Lot, unto the land that We had blessed for all beings.

72.sahih_international: And We gave him Isaac and Jacob in addition, and all [of them] We made righteous.
72.pickthall: And We bestowed upon him Isaac, and Jacob as a grandson. Each of them We made righteous.
72.yusuf_ali: And We bestowed on him Isaac and, as an additional gift, (a grandson), Jacob, and We made righteous men of every one (of them).
72.shakir: And We gave him Ishaq and Yaqoub, a son's son, and We made (them) all good.
72.muhammad_sarwar: We granted him Isaac and Jacob as a gift and helped both of them to become righteous people.
72.mohsin_khan: And We bestowed upon him Ishaque (Isaac), and (a grandson) Ya'qub (Jacob). Each one We made righteous.
72.arberry: And We gave him Isaac and Jacob in superfluity, and every one made We righteous

73.sahih_international: And We made them leaders guiding by Our command. And We inspired to them the doing of good deeds, establishment of prayer, and giving of zakah; and they were worshippers of Us.
73.pickthall: And We made them chiefs who guide by Our command, and We inspired in them the doing of good deeds and the right establishment of worship and the giving of alms, and they were worshippers of Us (alone).
73.yusuf_ali: And We made them leaders, guiding (men) by Our Command, and We sent them inspiration to do good deeds, to establish regular prayers, and to practise regular charity; and they constantly served Us (and Us only).
73.shakir: And We made them Imams who guided (people) by Our command, and We revealed to them the doing of good and the keeping up of prayer and the giving of the alms, and Us (alone) did they serve;
73.muhammad_sarwar: We appointed them as leaders to guide the people through Our command and sent them revelation to strive for good deeds, worship their Lord, and pay religious tax. Both of them were Our worshipping servants.
73.mohsin_khan: And We made them leaders, guiding (mankind) by Our Command, and We inspired in them the doing of good deeds, performing Salat (Iqamat-as-Salat), and the giving of Zakat and of Us (Alone) they were worshippers.
73.arberry: and appointed them to be leaders guiding by Our command, and We revealed to them the doing of good deeds, and to perform the prayer, and to pay the alms, and Us they served.

74.sahih_international: And to Lot We gave judgement and knowledge, and We saved him from the city that was committing wicked deeds. Indeed, they were a people of evil, defiantly disobedient.
74.pickthall: And unto Lot we gave judgment and knowledge, and We delivered him from the community that did abominations. Lo! they were folk of evil, lewd.
74.yusuf_ali: And to Lut, too, We gave Judgment and Knowledge, and We saved him from the town which practised abominations: truly they were a people given to Evil, a rebellious people.
74.shakir: And (as for) Lut, We gave him wisdom and knowledge, and We delivered him from the town which wrought abominations; surely they were an evil people, transgressors;
74.muhammad_sarwar: To Lot We gave knowledge and wisdom and saved him from the people of the town who were committing indecent acts. They were certainly a bad and sinful people.
74.mohsin_khan: And (remember) Lout (Lot), We gave him Hukman (right judgement of the affairs and Prophethood) and (religious) knowledge, and We saved him from the town (folk) who practised Al-Khaba'ith (evil, wicked and filthy deeds, etc.). Verily, they were a people given to evil, and were Fasiqun (rebellious, disobedient, to Allah).
74.arberry: And Lot -- to him We gave judgment and knowledge; and we delivered him from the city that had been doing deeds of corruption; they were an evil people, truly ungodly;

75.sahih_international: And We admitted him into Our mercy. Indeed, he was of the righteous.
75.pickthall: And We brought him in unto Our mercy. Lo! he was of the righteous.
75.yusuf_ali: And We admitted him to Our Mercy: for he was one of the Righteous.
75.shakir: And We took him into Our mercy; surely he was of the good.
75.muhammad_sarwar: We encompassed him in Our mercy; he was a righteous man.
75.mohsin_khan: And We admitted him to Our Mercy, truly, he was of the righteous.
75.arberry: and We admitted him into Our mercy; he was of the righteous.

76.sahih_international: And [mention] Noah, when he called [to Allah] before [that time], so We responded to him and saved him and his family from the great flood.
76.pickthall: And Noah, when he cried of old, We heard his prayer and saved him and his household from the great affliction.
76.yusuf_ali: (Remember) Noah, when he cried (to Us) aforetime: We listened to his (prayer) and delivered him and his family from great distress.
76.shakir: And Nuh, when he cried aforetime, so We answered him, and delivered him and his followers from the great calamity.
76.muhammad_sarwar: We answered the prayer of Noah who had prayed to Us before and saved him and his followers from the great disaster.
76.mohsin_khan: And (remember) Nuh (Noah), when he cried (to Us) aforetime. We listened to his invocation and saved him and his family from great distress.
76.arberry: And Noah -- when he called before, and We answered him, and delivered him and his people from the great distress,

77.sahih_international: And We saved him from the people who denied Our signs. Indeed, they were a people of evil, so We drowned them, all together.
77.pickthall: And delivered him from the people who denied Our revelations. Lo! they were folk of evil, therefor did We drown them all.
77.yusuf_ali: We helped him against people who rejected Our Signs: truly they were a people given to Evil: so We drowned them (in the Flood) all together.
77.shakir: And We helped him against the people who rejected Our communications; surely they were an evil people, so We drowned them all.
77.muhammad_sarwar: We helped him against the people who said Our revelations were mere lies. They were a bad people and We drowned them all.
77.mohsin_khan: We helped him against people who denied Our Ayat (proofs, evidences, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.). Verily, they were a people given to evil. So We drowned them all.
77.arberry: and We helped him against the people who cried lies to Our signs; surely they were an evil people, so We drowned them all together.

78.sahih_international: And [mention] David and Solomon, when they judged concerning the field - when the sheep of a people overran it [at night], and We were witness to their judgement.
78.pickthall: And David and Solomon, when they gave judgment concerning the field, when people's sheep had strayed and browsed therein by night; and We were witnesses to their judgment.
78.yusuf_ali: And remember David and Solomon, when they gave judgment in the matter of the field into which the sheep of certain people had strayed by night: We did witness their judgment.
78.shakir: And Dawood and Sulaiman when they gave judgment concerning the field when the people's sheep pastured therein by night, and We were bearers of witness to their judgment.
78.muhammad_sarwar: David and Solomon were trying to settle the case of the people's sheep that grazed in a corn-field at night. We witnessed their decree in that matter.
78.mohsin_khan: And (remember) Dawud (David) and Sulaiman (Solomon), when they gave judgement in the case of the field in which the sheep of certain people had pastured at night and We were witness to their judgement.
78.arberry: And David and Solomon -- when they gave judgment concerning the tillage, when the sheep of the people strayed there, and We bore witness to their judgment;

79.sahih_international: And We gave understanding of the case to Solomon, and to each [of them] We gave judgement and knowledge. And We subjected the mountains to exalt [Us], along with David and [also] the birds. And We were doing [that].
79.pickthall: And We made Solomon to understand (the case); and unto each of them We gave judgment and knowledge. And we subdued the hills and the birds to hymn (His) praise along with David. We were the doers (thereof).
79.yusuf_ali: To Solomon We inspired the (right) understanding of the matter: to each (of them) We gave Judgment and Knowledge; it was Our power that made the hills and the birds celebrate Our praises, with David: it was We Who did (all these things).
79.shakir: So We made Sulaiman to understand it; and to each one We gave wisdom and knowledge; and We made the mountains, and the birds to celebrate Our praise with Dawood; and We were the doers.
79.muhammad_sarwar: We made Solomon understand the law about the case and gave both David and Solomon knowledge and wisdom. We made the mountains and birds glorify the Lord along with David. We had also done to him such favors before.
79.mohsin_khan: And We made Sulaiman (Solomon) to understand (the case), and to each of them We gave Hukman (right judgement of the affairs and Prophethood) and knowledge. And We subjected the mountains and the birds to glorify Our Praises along with Dawud (David), And it was We Who were the doers (of all these things).
79.arberry: and We made Solomon to understand it, and unto each gave We judgment and knowledge. And with David We subjected the mountains to give glory, and the birds, and We were doers.

80.sahih_international: And We taught him the fashioning of coats of armor to protect you from your [enemy in] battle. So will you then be grateful?
80.pickthall: And We taught him the art of making garments (of mail) to protect you in your daring. Are ye then thankful?
80.yusuf_ali: It was We Who taught him the making of coats of mail for your benefit, to guard you from each other's violence: will ye then be grateful?
80.shakir: And We taught him the making of coats of mail for you, that they might protect you in your wars; will you then be grateful?
80.muhammad_sarwar: We taught him the art of making coats of mail so that you could protect yourselves during a war. Will you then give thanks?
80.mohsin_khan: And We taught him the making of metal coats of mail (for battles), to protect you in your fighting. Are you then grateful?
80.arberry: And We taught him the fashioning of garments for you, to fortify you against your violence; then are you thankful?

81.sahih_international: And to Solomon [We subjected] the wind, blowing forcefully, proceeding by his command toward the land which We had blessed. And We are ever, of all things, Knowing.
81.pickthall: And unto Solomon (We subdued) the wind in its raging. It set by his command toward the land which We had blessed. And of everything We are Aware.
81.yusuf_ali: (It was Our power that made) the violent (unruly) wind flow (tamely) for Solomon, to his order, to the land which We had blessed: for We do know all things.
81.shakir: And (We made subservient) to Sulaiman the wind blowing violent, pursuing its course by his command to the land which We had blessed, and We are knower of all things.
81.muhammad_sarwar: We made subservient to Solomon the swift wind that blew on his command to the land in which We had sent blessings. We have the knowledge of all things.
81.mohsin_khan: And to Sulaiman (Solomon) (We subjected) the wind strongly raging, running by his command towards the land which We had blessed. And of everything We are the All-Knower.
81.arberry: And to Solomon the wind, strongly blowing, that ran at his command unto the land that We had blessed; and We had knowledge of everything;

82.sahih_international: And of the devils were those who dived for him and did work other than that. And We were of them a guardian.
82.pickthall: And of the evil ones (subdued We unto him) some who dived (for pearls) for him and did other work, and We were warders unto them.
82.yusuf_ali: And of the evil ones, were some who dived for him, and did other work besides; and it was We Who guarded them.
82.shakir: And of the rebellious people there were those who dived for him and did other work besides that, and We kept guard over them;
82.muhammad_sarwar: We subdued the devils who would dive into the sea for him and perform other tasks for Solomon. We kept them in his service.
82.mohsin_khan: And of the Shayatin (devils) (from the jinns) were some who dived for him, and did other work besides that; and it was We Who guarded them.
82.arberry: and of the Satans some dived for him and did other work besides; and We were watching over them.

83.sahih_international: And [mention] Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, adversity has touched me, and you are the Most Merciful of the merciful."
83.pickthall: And Job, when he cried unto his Lord, (saying): Lo! adversity afflicteth me, and Thou art Most Merciful of all who show mercy.
83.yusuf_ali: And (remember) Job, when He cried to his Lord, "Truly distress has seized me, but Thou art the Most Merciful of those that are merciful."
83.shakir: And Ayub, when he cried to his Lord, (saying): Harm has afflicted me, and Thou art the most Merciful of the merciful.
83.muhammad_sarwar: When Job prayed, "Lord, I have been afflicted with hardships. Have mercy on me; You are the Most Merciful of those who have mercy,
83.mohsin_khan: And (remember) Ayub (Job), when he cried to his Lord: "Verily, distress has seized me, and You are the Most Merciful of all those who show mercy."
83.arberry: And Job -- when he called unto his Lord, 'Behold, affliction has visited me, and Thou art the most merciful of the merciful.'

84.sahih_international: So We responded to him and removed what afflicted him of adversity. And We gave him [back] his family and the like thereof with them as mercy from Us and a reminder for the worshippers [of Allah].
84.pickthall: Then We heard his prayer and removed that adversity from which he suffered, and We gave him his household (that he had lost) and the like thereof along with them, a mercy from Our store, and a remembrance for the worshippers;
84.yusuf_ali: So We listened to him: We removed the distress that was on him, and We restored his people to him, and doubled their number,- as a Grace from Ourselves, and a thing for commemoration, for all who serve Us.
84.shakir: Therefore We responded to him and took off what harm he had, and We gave him his family and the like of them with them: a mercy from Us and a reminder to the worshippers.
84.muhammad_sarwar: "We answered his prayer, relieved him from his hardships, brought his family (back to him) and gave him twice as much property as that (which was destroyed). It was a mercy from Us and a reminder for the worshippers.
