84.mohsin_khan: So We answered his call, and We removed the distress that was on him, and We restored his family to him (that he had lost), and the like thereof along with them, as a mercy from Ourselves and a Reminder for all who worship Us.
84.arberry: So We answered him, and removed the affliction that was upon him, and We gave his people, and the like of them with them, mercy from Us, and a Reminder to those who serve.

85.sahih_international: And [mention] Ishmael and Idrees and Dhul-Kifl; all were of the patient.
85.pickthall: And (mention) Ishmael, and Idris, and Dhu'l-Kifl. All were of the steadfast.
85.yusuf_ali: And (remember) Isma'il, Idris, and Zul-kifl, all (men) of constancy and patience;
85.shakir: And Ismail and Idris and Zulkifl; all were of the patient ones;
85.muhammad_sarwar: Ismael, Idris and Dhul Kifl all were people of great patience.
85.mohsin_khan: And (remember) Isma'il (Ishmael), and Idris (Enoch) and Dhul-Kifl (Isaiah), all were from among As-Sabirin (the patient ones, etc.).
85.arberry: And Ishmael, Idris, Dhul Kifl -- each was of the patient,

86.sahih_international: And We admitted them into Our mercy. Indeed, they were of the righteous.
86.pickthall: And We brought them in unto Our mercy. Lo! they are among the righteous.
86.yusuf_ali: We admitted them to Our mercy: for they were of the righteous ones.
86.shakir: And We caused them to enter into Our mercy, surely they were of the good ones.
86.muhammad_sarwar: We encompassed them in Our mercy; they were righteous people.
86.mohsin_khan: And We admitted them to Our Mercy. Verily, they were of the righteous.
86.arberry: and We admitted them into Our mercy; they were of the righteous.

87.sahih_international: And [mention] the man of the fish, when he went off in anger and thought that We would not decree [anything] upon him. And he called out within the darknesses, "There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers."
87.pickthall: And (mention) Dhu'n-Nun, when he went off in anger and deemed that We had no power over him, but he cried out in the darkness, saying: There is no Allah save Thee. Be Thou Glorified! Lo! I have been a wrong-doer.
87.yusuf_ali: And remember Zun-nun, when he departed in wrath: He imagined that We had no power over him! But he cried through the deptHs of darkness, "There is no god but thou: glory to thee: I was indeed wrong!"
87.shakir: And Yunus, when he went away in wrath, so he thought that We would not straiten him, so he called out among afflictions: There is no god but Thou, glory be to Thee; surely I am of those who make themselves to suffer loss.
87.muhammad_sarwar: Dhun Nun went away in anger and thought that We would never have power over him, but in darkness he cried, "Lord, You are the Only God whom I glorify. I have certainly done wrong to myself (so forgive me)".
87.mohsin_khan: And (remember) Dhan-Nun (Jonah), when he went off in anger, and imagined that We shall not punish him (i.e. the calamites which had befallen him)! But he cried through the darkness (saying): La ilaha illa Anta [none has the right to be worshipped but You (O Allah)], Glorified (and Exalted) are You [above all that (evil) they associate with You]. Truly, I have been of the wrong-doers."
87.arberry: And Dhul Nun -- when he went forth enraged and thought that We would have no power over him; then he called out in the darkness, 'There is no god but Thou. Glory be to Thee! I have done evil.'

88.sahih_international: So We responded to him and saved him from the distress. And thus do We save the believers.
88.pickthall: Then we heard his prayer and saved him from the anguish. Thus we save believers.
88.yusuf_ali: So We listened to him: and delivered him from distress: and thus do We deliver those who have faith.
88.shakir: So We responded to him and delivered him from the grief and thus do We deliver the believers.
88.muhammad_sarwar: We answered his prayer and saved him from his grief. Thus We save the faithful ones.
88.mohsin_khan: So We answered his call, and delivered him from the distress. And thus We do deliver the believers (who believe in the Oneness of Allah, abstain from evil and work righteousness).
88.arberry: So We answered him, and delivered him out of grief; even so do, We deliver the believers.

89.sahih_international: And [mention] Zechariah, when he called to his Lord, "My Lord, do not leave me alone [with no heir], while you are the best of inheritors."
89.pickthall: And Zachariah, when he cried unto his Lord: My Lord! Leave me not childless, though Thou art the Best of inheritors.
89.yusuf_ali: And (remember) Zakariya, when he cried to his Lord: "O my Lord! leave me not without offspring, though thou art the best of inheritors."
89.shakir: And Zakariya, when he cried to his Lord: O my Lord leave me not alone; and Thou art the best of inheritors.
89.muhammad_sarwar: Zachariah prayed, "Lord, do not leave me alone without offspring, although you are the best heir".
89.mohsin_khan: And (remember) Zakariya (Zachariah), when he cried to his Lord: "O My Lord! Leave me not single (childless), though You are the Best of the inheritors."
89.arberry: And Zachariah -- when he called unto his Lord, 'O my Lord, leave me not solitary; though Thou art the best of inheritors.'

90.sahih_international: So We responded to him, and We gave to him John, and amended for him his wife. Indeed, they used to hasten to good deeds and supplicate Us in hope and fear, and they were to Us humbly submissive.
90.pickthall: Then We heard his prayer, and bestowed upon him John, and adjusted his wife (to bear a child) for him. Lo! they used to vie one with the other in good deeds, and they cried unto Us in longing and in fear, and were submissive unto Us.
90.yusuf_ali: So We listened to him: and We granted him Yahya: We cured his wife's (Barrenness) for him. These (three) were ever quick in emulation in good works; they used to call on Us with love and reverence, and humble themselves before Us.
90.shakir: So We responded to him and gave him Yahya and made his wife fit for him; surely they used to hasten, one with another In deeds of goodness and to call upon Us, hoping and fearing and they were humble before Us.
90.muhammad_sarwar: We answered his prayer and granted him his son, John, by making his wife fruitful. They were people who would compete with each other in good deeds and pray to Us with love and reverence. With Us they were all humble people.
90.mohsin_khan: So We answered his call, and We bestowed upon him Yahya (John), and cured his wife (to bear a child) for him. Verily, they used to hasten on to do good deeds, and they used to call on Us with hope and fear, and used to humble themselves before Us.
90.arberry: So We answered him, and bestowed on him John, and We set his wife right for him; truly they vied with one another, hastening to good works, and called upon Us out of yearning and awe; and they were humble to Us.

91.sahih_international: And [mention] the one who guarded her chastity, so We blew into her [garment] through Our angel [Gabriel], and We made her and her son a sign for the worlds.
91.pickthall: And she who was chaste, therefor We breathed into her (something) of Our Spirit and made her and her son a token for (all) peoples.
91.yusuf_ali: And (remember) her who guarded her chastity: We breathed into her of Our spirit, and We made her and her son a sign for all peoples.
91.shakir: And she who guarded her chastity, so We breathed into her of Our inspiration and made her and her son a sign for the nations.
91.muhammad_sarwar: Into the woman who maintained her chastity We breathed Our Spirit and made her and her son a miracle for all people.
91.mohsin_khan: And (remember) she who guarded her chastity [Virgin Maryam (Mary)], We breathed into (the sleeves of) her (shirt or garment) [through Our Ruh - Jibrael (Gabriel)], and We made her and her son ['Iesa (Jesus)] a sign for Al-'Alamin (the mankind and jinns).
91.arberry: And she who guarded her virginity, so We breathed into her of Our spirit and appointed her and her son to be a sign unto all beings.

92.sahih_international: Indeed this, your religion, is one religion, and I am your Lord, so worship Me.
92.pickthall: Lo! this, your religion, is one religion, and I am your Lord, so worship Me.
92.yusuf_ali: Verily, this brotherhood of yours is a single brotherhood, and I am your Lord and Cherisher: therefore serve Me (and no other).
92.shakir: Surely this Islam is your religion, one religion (only), and I am your Lord, therefore serve Me.
92.muhammad_sarwar: People, you are one nation and I am your Lord. Worship Me.
92.mohsin_khan: Truly! This, your Ummah [Sharia or religion (Islamic Monotheism)] is one religion, and I am your Lord, therefore worship Me (Alone). [Tafsir Ibn Kathir]
92.arberry: 'Surely this community of yours is one community, and I am your Lord; so serve Me.'

93.sahih_international: And [yet] they divided their affair among themselves, [but] all to Us will return.
93.pickthall: And they have broken their religion (into fragments) among them, (yet) all are returning unto Us.
93.yusuf_ali: But (later generations) cut off their affair (of unity), one from another: (yet) will they all return to Us.
93.shakir: And they broke their religion (into sects) between them: to Us shall all come back.
93.muhammad_sarwar: People have divided themselves into many sects, but all will return to Us.
93.mohsin_khan: But they have broken up and differed as regards their religion among themselves. (And) they all shall return to Us.
93.arberry: But they split up their affair between them; all shall return to Us.

94.sahih_international: So whoever does righteous deeds while he is a believer - no denial will there be for his effort, and indeed We, of it, are recorders.
94.pickthall: Then whoso doeth some good works and is a believer, there will be no rejection of his effort. Lo! We record (it) for him.
94.yusuf_ali: Whoever works any act of righteousness and has faith,- His endeavour will not be rejected: We shall record it in his favour.
94.shakir: Therefore whoever shall do of good deeds and he is a believer, there shall be no denying of his exertion, and surely We will write (It) down for him.
94.muhammad_sarwar: The reward of the righteously striving believers will not be neglected. We are keeping the record of their good deeds.
94.mohsin_khan: So whoever does righteous good deeds while he is a believer (in the Oneness of Allah Islamic Monotheism), his efforts will not be rejected. Verily! We record it in his Book of deeds.
94.arberry: And whosoever does deeds of righteousness, being a believer, no unthankfulness shall befall his endeavour; We Ourselves write it down for him.

95.sahih_international: And there is prohibition upon [the people of] a city which We have destroyed that they will [ever] return
95.pickthall: And there is a ban upon any community which We have destroyed: that they shall not return.
95.yusuf_ali: But there is a ban on any population which We have destroyed: that they shall not return,
95.shakir: And it is binding on a town which We destroy that they shall not return.
95.muhammad_sarwar: The people whom We destroyed can never return to this world
95.mohsin_khan: And a ban is laid on every town (population) which We have destroyed that they shall not return (to this world again, nor repent to Us).
95.arberry: There is a ban upon any city that We have destroyed; they shall not return

96.sahih_international: Until when [the dam of] Gog and Magog has been opened and they, from every elevation, descend
96.pickthall: Until, when Gog and Magog are let loose, and they hasten out of every mound,
96.yusuf_ali: Until the Gog and Magog (people) are let through (their barrier), and they swiftly swarm from every hill.
96.shakir: Even when Gog and Magog are let loose and they shall break forth from every elevated place.
96.muhammad_sarwar: until Gog and Magog are let loose to rush down from the hills.
96.mohsin_khan: Until, when Ya'juj and Ma'juj (Gog and Magog) are let loose (from their barrier), and they swiftly swarm from every mound.
96.arberry: till, when Gog and Magog are unloosed, and they slide down out of every slope,

97.sahih_international: And [when] the true promise has approached; then suddenly the eyes of those who disbelieved will be staring [in horror, while they say], "O woe to us; we had been unmindful of this; rather, we were wrongdoers."
97.pickthall: And the True Promise draweth nigh; then behold them, staring wide (in terror), the eyes of those who disbelieve! (They say): Alas for us! We (lived) in forgetfulness of this. Ah, but we were wrong-doers!
97.yusuf_ali: Then will the true promise draw nigh (of fulfilment): then behold! the eyes of the Unbelievers will fixedly stare in horror: "Ah! Woe to us! we were indeed heedless of this; nay, we truly did wrong!"
97.shakir: And the true promise shall draw nigh, then lo! the eyes of those who disbelieved shall be fixedly open: O woe to us! surely we were in a state of heedlessness as to this; nay, we were unjust.
97.muhammad_sarwar: The Day of Judgment will then draw near and the unbelievers will stare amazedly and cry, "Woe to us! We had neglected this day. We have done wrong".
97.mohsin_khan: And the true promise (Day of Resurrection) shall draw near (of fulfillment). Then (when mankind is resurrected from their graves), you shall see the eyes of the disbelievers fixedly stare in horror. (They will say): "Woe to us! We were indeed heedless of this; nay, but we were Zalimun (polytheists and wrong-doers, etc.)."
97.arberry: and nigh has drawn the true promise, and behold, the eyes of the unbelievers staring: 'Alas for us! We were heedless of this; 'nay, we were evildoers.'

98.sahih_international: Indeed, you [disbelievers] and what you worship other than Allah are the firewood of Hell. You will be coming to [enter] it.
98.pickthall: Lo! ye (idolaters) and that which ye worship beside Allah are fuel of hell. Thereunto ye will come.
98.yusuf_ali: Verily ye, (unbelievers), and the (false) gods that ye worship besides Allah, are (but) fuel for Hell! to it will ye (surely) come!
98.shakir: Surely you and what you worship besides Allah are the firewood of hell; to it you shall come.
98.muhammad_sarwar: They will be told, "You and what you had worshipped instead of God will be the fuel of hell".
98.mohsin_khan: Certainly! You (disbelievers) and that which you are worshipping now besides Allah, are (but) fuel for Hell! (Surely), you will enter it.
98.arberry: 'Surely you, and that you were serving apart from God, are fuel for Gehenna; you shall go down to it.'

99.sahih_international: Had these [false deities] been [actual] gods, they would not have come to it, but all are eternal therein.
99.pickthall: If these had been gods they would not have come thither, but all will abide therein.
99.yusuf_ali: If these had been gods, they would not have got there! but each one will abide therein.
99.shakir: Had these been gods, they would not have come to it and all shall abide therein.
99.muhammad_sarwar: Had the idols been true lords, they would not have gone to hell. "All of you will live therein forever".
99.mohsin_khan: Had these (idols, etc.) been aliha (gods), they would not have entered there (Hell), and all of them will abide therein.
99.arberry: If those had been gods, they would never have gone down to it; yet every one of them shall therein abide forever;'

100.sahih_international: For them therein is heavy sighing, and they therein will not hear.
100.pickthall: Therein wailing is their portion, and therein they hear not.
100.yusuf_ali: There, sobbing will be their lot, nor will they there hear (aught else).
100.shakir: For them therein shall be groaning and therein they shall not hear.
100.muhammad_sarwar: They will groan in pain therein, but no one will listen to them.
100.mohsin_khan: Therein breathing out with deep sighs and roaring will be their portion, and therein they will hear not.
100.arberry: there shall be sighing for them therein, and naught they shall hear.

101.sahih_international: Indeed, those for whom the best [reward] has preceded from Us - they are from it far removed.
101.pickthall: Lo! those unto whom kindness hath gone forth before from Us, they will be far removed from thence.
101.yusuf_ali: Those for whom the good (record) from Us has gone before, will be removed far therefrom.
101.shakir: Surely (as for) those for whom the good has already gone forth from Us, they shall be kept far off from it;
101.muhammad_sarwar: But those to whom We have already promised blessings will be far away from hell.
101.mohsin_khan: Verily those for whom the good has preceded from Us, they will be removed far therefrom (Hell) [e.g. 'Iesa (Jesus), son of Maryam (Mary); 'Uzair (Ezra), etc.].
101.arberry: But as for those unto whom already the reward most fair has gone forth from Us,

102.sahih_international: They will not hear its sound, while they are, in that which their souls desire, abiding eternally.
102.pickthall: They will not hear the slightest sound thereof, while they abide in that which their souls desire.
102.yusuf_ali: Not the slightest sound will they hear of Hell: what their souls desired, in that will they dwell.
102.shakir: They will not hear its faintest sound, and they shall abide in that which their souls long for.
102.muhammad_sarwar: They will not even hear the slightest sound from it while enjoying the best that they can wish for in their everlasting life.
102.mohsin_khan: They shall not hear the slightest sound of it (Hell), while they abide in that which their ownselves desire.
102.arberry: they shall be, kept far from it neither shall they hear any whisper of it, and they shall dwell forever in that their souls desired;

103.sahih_international: They will not be grieved by the greatest terror, and the angels will meet them, [saying], "This is your Day which you have been promised" -
103.pickthall: The Supreme Horror will not grieve them, and the angels will welcome them, (saying): This is your Day which ye were promised;
103.yusuf_ali: The Great Terror will bring them no grief: but the angels will meet them (with mutual greetings): "This is your Day,- (the Day) that ye were promised."
103.shakir: The great fearful event shall not grieve them, and the angels shall meet them: This is your day which you were promised.
103.muhammad_sarwar: They will not be affected by the great terror. The angels will come to them with this glad news: "This is your day which was promised to you."
103.mohsin_khan: The greatest terror (on the Day of Resurrection) will not grieve them, and the angels will meet them, (with the greeting): "This is your Day which you were promised."
103.arberry: the greatest terror shall not grieve them, and the angels shall receive them: 'This is your day that you were promised.'

104.sahih_international: The Day when We will fold the heaven like the folding of a [written] sheet for the records. As We began the first creation, We will repeat it. [That is] a promise binding upon Us. Indeed, We will do it.
104.pickthall: The Day when We shall roll up the heavens as a recorder rolleth up a written scroll. As We began the first creation, We shall repeat it. (It is) a promise (binding) upon Us. Lo! We are to perform it.
104.yusuf_ali: The Day that We roll up the heavens like a scroll rolled up for books (completed),- even as We produced the first creation, so shall We produce a new one: a promise We have undertaken: truly shall We fulfil it.
104.shakir: On the day when We will roll up heaven like the rolling up of the scroll for writings, as We originated the first creation, (so) We shall reproduce it; a promise (binding on Us); surely We will bring it about.
104.muhammad_sarwar: (This will happen) on the day when We roll up the heavens as if it were a written scroll and bring it back into existence just as though We had created it for the first time. This is what We have promised and We have always been true to Our promise.
104.mohsin_khan: And (remember) the Day when We shall roll up the heavens like a scroll rolled up for books, as We began the first creation, We shall repeat it, (it is) a promise binding upon Us. Truly, We shall do it.
104.arberry: On the day when We shall roll up heaven as a scroll is rolled for the writings; as We originated the first creation, so We shall bring it back again -- a promise binding on Us; so We shall do.

105.sahih_international: And We have already written in the book [of Psalms] after the [previous] mention that the land [of Paradise] is inherited by My righteous servants.
105.pickthall: And verily we have written in the Scripture, after the Reminder: My righteous slaves will inherit the earth:
105.yusuf_ali: Before this We wrote in the Psalms, after the Message (given to Moses): My servants the righteous, shall inherit the earth."
105.shakir: And certainly We wrote in the Book after the reminder that (as for) the land, My righteous servants shall inherit it.
105.muhammad_sarwar: We have written in the psalms which We had revealed after the Torah that the earth will be given to Our righteous servants as their inheritance.
105.mohsin_khan: And indeed We have written in Zabur (Psalms) [i.e. all the revealed Holy Books the Taurat (Torah), the Injeel (Gospel), the Quran] after (We have already written in) Al-Lauh Al-Mahfuz (the Book, that is in the heaven with Allah), that My righteous slaves shall inherit the land (i.e. the land of Paradise).
105.arberry: For We have written in the Psalms, after the Remembrance, 'The earth shall be the inheritance of My righteous servants.'

106.sahih_international: Indeed, in this [Qur'an] is notification for a worshipping people.
106.pickthall: Lo! there is a plain statement for folk who are devout.
106.yusuf_ali: Verily in this (Qur'an) is a Message for people who would (truly) worship Allah.
106.shakir: Most surely in this is a message to a people who serve
106.muhammad_sarwar: This is a lesson for those who worship (God).
106.mohsin_khan: Verily, in this (the Quran) there is a plain Message for people who worship Allah (i.e. the true, real believers of Islamic Monotheism who act practically on the Quran and the Sunnah legal ways of the Prophet SAW).
106.arberry: Surely in this is a Message delivered unto a people who serve.

107.sahih_international: And We have not sent you, [O Muhammad], except as a mercy to the worlds.
107.pickthall: We sent thee not save as a mercy for the peoples.
107.yusuf_ali: We sent thee not, but as a Mercy for all creatures.
107.shakir: And We have not sent you but as a mercy to the worlds.
107.muhammad_sarwar: (Muhammad), We have sent you for no other reason but to be a mercy for mankind.
107.mohsin_khan: And We have sent you (O Muhammad SAW) not but as a mercy for the 'Alamin (mankind, jinns and all that exists).
107.arberry: We have not sent thee, save as a mercy unto all beings.

108.sahih_international: Say, "It is only revealed to me that your god is but one God; so will you be Muslims [in submission to Him]?"
108.pickthall: Say: It is only inspired in me that your Allah is One Allah. Will ye then surrender (unto Him)?
108.yusuf_ali: Say: "What has come to me by inspiration is that your Allah is One Allah: will ye therefore bow to His Will (in Islam)?"
108.shakir: Say: It is only revealed to me that your Allah is one Allah; will you then submit?
108.muhammad_sarwar: Say, "It is revealed to me that there is only one Lord. Will you then submit yourselves to His will?"
108.mohsin_khan: Say (O Muhammad SAW): "It is revealed to me that your Ilah (God) is only one Ilah (God - Allah). Will you then submit to His Will (become Muslims and stop worshipping others besides Allah)?"
108.arberry: Say: 'It is revealed unto me only that your God is One God; do you then surrender?'

109.sahih_international: But if they turn away, then say, "I have announced to [all of] you equally. And I know not whether near or far is that which you are promised.
109.pickthall: But if they are averse, then say: I have warned you all alike, although I know not whether nigh or far is that which ye are promised.
109.yusuf_ali: But if they turn back, Say: "I have proclaimed the Message to you all alike and in truth; but I know not whether that which ye are promised is near or far.
109.shakir: But if they turn back, say: I have given you warning in fairness and I do not know whether what you are threatened with is near or far;
109.muhammad_sarwar: If they turn away, tell them, "I have warned every one of you equally. I do not know when the torment which you have to suffer will take place.
109.mohsin_khan: But if they (disbelievers, idolaters, Jews, Christians, polytheists, etc.) turn away (from Islamic Monotheism) say (to them O Muhammad SAW): "I give you a notice (of war as) to be known to us all alike. And I know not whether that which you are promised (i.e. the torment or the Day of Resurrection) is near or far."
109.arberry: Then, if they should turn their backs, say: 'I have proclaimed to you all equally, even though I know not whether near or far is that you are promised.'

110.sahih_international: Indeed, He knows what is declared of speech, and He knows what you conceal.
110.pickthall: Lo! He knoweth that which is said openly, and that which ye conceal.
110.yusuf_ali: "It is He Who knows what is open in speech and what ye hide (in your hearts).
110.shakir: Surely He knows what is spoken openly and He knows what you hide;
110.muhammad_sarwar: God knows well all that is spoken aloud and all that you hide.
110.mohsin_khan: (Say O Muhammad SAW) Verily, He (Allah) knows that which is spoken aloud (openly) and that which you conceal.
110.arberry: Surely He knows what is spoken aloud and He knows what you hide.

111.sahih_international: And I know not; perhaps it is a trial for you and enjoyment for a time."
111.pickthall: And I know not but that this may be a trial for you, and enjoyment for a while.
111.yusuf_ali: "I know not but that it may be a trial for you, and a grant of (worldly) livelihood (to you) for a time."
111.shakir: And I do not know if this may be a trial for you and a provision till a time.
111.muhammad_sarwar: I do not know (why God has commanded me to warn you of the torment). Perhaps it is a trial for you and a respite for an appointed time".
111.mohsin_khan: And I know not, perhaps it may be a trial for you, and an enjoyment for a while.
111.arberry: I know not; haply it is a trial for you and an enjoyment for a time.

112.sahih_international: [The Prophet] has said, "My Lord, judge [between us] in truth. And our Lord is the Most Merciful, the one whose help is sought against that which you describe."
112.pickthall: He saith: My Lord! Judge Thou with truth. Our Lord is the Beneficent, Whose help is to be implored against that which ye ascribe (unto Him).
112.yusuf_ali: Say: "O my Lord! judge Thou in truth!" "Our Lord Most Gracious is the One Whose assistance should be sought against the blasphemies ye utter!"
112.shakir: He said: O my Lord! judge Thou with truth; and our Lord is the Beneficent Allah, Whose help is sought against what you ascribe (to Him).
112.muhammad_sarwar: He also said, "Lord, judge (us) with Truth. Our Lord is the Beneficent One whose help I ask against the blasphemies you say about Him".
112.mohsin_khan: He (Muhammad SAW) said:"My Lord! Judge You in truth! Our Lord is the Most Beneficent, Whose Help is to be sought against that which you attribute (unto Allah that He has offspring, and unto Muhammad SAW that he is a sorcerer, and unto the Quran that it is poetry, etc.)!"
112.arberry: He said: 'My Lord, judge Thou with truth! And our Lord is the All-merciful; His succour is ever to be sought against that you describe.'
